title: Towards Objective Estimation of Physical Functioning Status in Breast-Cancer Patients using Real-World Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Breast cancer is the most common invasive cancer in women, accounting for about one third of cancer cases. As with all cancers, its treatment may introduce side-effects like fatigue and reduced physical functioning, leading to a downward spiral of subsequent issues and severely affecting patient quality of life. On the positive side, physical functioning can be improved via personalized targeted interventions, tailored to the particularities of each case. However, continuous and objective monitoring of patients is a difficult task, owing to the limited clinical resources and the lack of appropriate tools. In this paper, we introduce a methodology for objectively estimating the physical functioning status of breast cancer patients from wearable smartwatch data. We show that features derived from longitudinal walking and heart rate measurements correlate significantly with phys- ical functioning scores of established patient-reported out

translated_title: 基于真实世界数据客观评估乳腺癌患者身体机能状态的方法研究
translated_abstract: 乳腺癌是女性中最常见的侵袭性癌症，约占所有癌症病例的三分之一。与所有癌症一样，其治疗可能引发疲劳和身体机能下降等副作用，导致一系列后续问题的恶性循环，严重影响患者的生活质量。积极的一面是，身体机能可以通过针对每个病例具体特点量身定制的个性化干预措施得到改善。然而，由于临床资源有限且缺乏合适的工具，对患者进行持续、客观的监测是一项困难的任务。本文提出了一种利用可穿戴智能手表数据客观评估乳腺癌患者身体机能状态的方法。我们证明了从纵向行走和心率测量中提取的特征与既定的患者报告结局（PRO）中的身体机能评分显著相关。（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种从智能手表真实世界数据中提取纵向行走和心率特征来客观评估乳腺癌患者身体机能状态的新方法，其特征与患者报告的身体机能评分显著相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a methodology for objectively estimating the physical functioning status of breast cancer patients from real-world wearable smartwatch data, showing that longitudinal walking and heart rate features significantly correlate with established patient-reported physical functioning scores.
